task.title: M5: core diff with rename map, per-file deltas, and edge changes
task.description:
Implement snapshot diffing in packages/core. Given base and head snapshots and a rename map derived from git diff -M --name-status <base> <head>, apply the renames so a moved file is compared with itself, then compute per-file deltas (code, complexity, churn, added, removed), function-level deltas, and the sets of added and removed edges at both file and module level. The diff output is its own typed structure that the UI and the compare command consume.

Acceptance criteria:
- renameMap(repo, base, head) parses git diff -M --name-status into { oldPath: newPath } including Rnnn similarity entries.
- diffSnapshots(base, head, renames) returns typed deltas; a renamed-only file shows zero metric change rather than delete plus add.
- Edge diff respects renames and reports added/removed edges with their level.
- Works when one side is module-level only (Go) and the other has file-level edges.
- Tests cover add, remove, modify, rename, rename-with-change, and edge churn fixtures.
